verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a console Usage page for viewing monthly instance usage. The Lambda Cloud API is documented for creating and managing resources such as instances and workspaces, but no API endpoint for usage or billing data appears. Nothing supports breaking down spend by team or workload either. A UI-only usage view is an adjacent feature, not programmatic billing export.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
